name: ai-chat-reveal-landscape
title: AI Chat Reveal (landscape)
description: A question is typed in a chat app, sent, and answered by an AI that streams its reply word by word on a measured token rhythm: thinking dot, uneven bursts, a bulleted list. The app's white to the frame edge, the chat column with header and Russian keyboard in the middle. Question, answer and four beat times are variables; holds the finished answer to the end of the mount.
author: Miao Yang
